summary: Make R19 production capture source replacement transactional so transient texture/SRV creation failures preserve the last complete published source bundle.

C0_RECOVER.evidence: Recovered latest GitHub HEAD 5912dee3955138baba3172cc7eb18f52f18c2f86 after finalizing CONVERSION-DX9EX-00463. Structural extraction remains terminal and Architecture v3 remains HMD-gated, so the next independent R19 resource-lifetime unit is eligible.

C1_REVIEW.evidence: EnsureSource discarded the current Source/SourceSrv before allocating a replacement for changed dimensions/format. A transient CreateTexture2D/CreateShaderResourceView failure therefore removed the last complete fallback capture even though its prior freshness timestamp had not expired.

C2_IMPLEMENT.evidence: Create replacement texture/SRV into pending local COM pointers, release pending objects on failure, and publish globals only after both succeed. Old Source/SourceSrv and metadata remain untouched on failure; freshness timestamps are still updated only after a successful CopyResource in PublishProductionCapture.

code_review: Old EnsureSource called ReleaseCom(SourceSrv/Source) before replacement allocation.
New creation targets pendingSource/pendingSourceSrv and only then swaps globals.
PublishProductionCapture retains timestamp/monitor/output updates after EnsureSource and successful CopyResource, so failed replacement cannot be mislabeled as a fresh capture.
